blocks.text: The route's final natural highlight is Lençóis Maranhenses. After the rainy season, lagoons of warm, clear water remain between the white dunes. In daylight the blue lagoons stand out sharply against the sand. Towards evening, their surfaces reflect the softer light. The next day, the scenery changes as you travel by motorboat along the Preguiças River, passing mangroves, villages and sandy banks. From the lighthouse you can see the river, the ocean, the dunes and the green coastline.

blocks.text:
Arrival in Rio de Janeiro. Meeting at the airport and transfer to the hotel. Free time. Overnight in the hotel.

Rio de Janeiro has green hills, blue sky, beautiful bays, islands and marvelous beaches. It is the second biggest city in Brazil (after Sao Paulo) and, certainly, one of the most beautiful cities in the world! Blue ocean water will call you to the beach. Enjoy your time in this paradise city! You can enjoy the exciting life of the city or relax among the palm trees drinking coconut water and listening to samba. Whatever you choose - Rio is all yours! Blue ocean water will call you to the beach. The most popular beaches - Copacabana, Ipanema and Leblon, are famous for their black and white tiled promenade. Numerous open cafeterias on the beach will offer you refreshing coconut water, freshly squeezed juices and other drinks. You can also see presentations of local musicians on the beach playing all kinds of music, people practicing sports, enjoying themselves. Emerge yourself in the rhythm of the city.
